name: mtva-skills
description: House Claude Code skills for MTVA admin staff — attendance analysis and student-facing PDF reports, video footage transcription and indexing, and classroom material generation.

plugins.name: office-toolkit
plugins.description: Everyday school-office work: polished printable PDFs via Typst, the weekly notice sheet, reimbursement summaries for signature, letters to parents, inbox triage with drafted replies, and the weekly Constant Contact newsletter. Use for notice sheets, bulletins, expenses, receipts, parent letters, inbox catch-up, or the weekly parent email.

plugins.name: student-reports
plugins.description: Turn attendance, grade, or roster spreadsheets into analysis and per-student PDF reports. Reads .xlsx/.csv, computes rates and flags, and renders one letterheaded PDF per student via Typst. Use for attendance letters, progress reports, and any batch of parent-facing documents driven by a spreadsheet.

plugins.name: footage-review
plugins.description: Review video footage without scrubbing timelines. Identifies which enrolled students appear in each clip by face, transcribes audio locally with ffmpeg and Whisper, builds a timestamped searchable index, and cuts clips and stills by timestamp. Everything runs on the machine — footage never leaves it.

plugins.name: classroom-materials
plugins.description: Turn a source text into classroom-ready material — worksheets with answer keys, differentiated reading-level variants, vocabulary sets, and quizzes — as Word documents teachers can edit.

plugins.name: tva-newsletter
plugins.description: The weekly MTVA and YTVA Shabbat newsletters in Constant Contact. Staff drop the week's pieces (dvar Torah, update, photos, mazal tovs, birthdays, podcasts, flyers) in a folder; Claude fills each program's fixed house template, hosts the photos, and creates the draft and test send. Sending to families stays a human decision.
